title: An NLP-inherited motif confers broad DNA-binding specificity to NIN in root nodule symbiosis
authors: Shohei Nosaki; Momona Noda; Hiroki Onoda; Momoyo Ito; Takuya Suzaki
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构域和突变分析揭示NIN转录因子中FR基序通过稳定RWP-RK二聚体界面拓宽DNA结合特异性，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，但方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟成分有限。
abstract: Nitrogen-fixing root nodule symbiosis (RNS) occurs in some eudicots, including legumes, and is regulated by the transcription factor NODULE INCEPTION (NIN), derived from the NIN-LIKE PROTEIN (NLP) family. However, how the NIN protein acquired RNS-specific functions remains unclear. We identify a previously undescribed motif in Lotus japonicus NIN, located downstream of the RWP-RK domain, which we term the FR. This motif broadens the DNA-binding specificity of NIN by stabilizing the RWP-RK dimer interface. nin mutants lacking the FR motif show defective nodulation and impaired nitrogen fixation. Arabidopsis NLP2 carries a NIN-type FR and shares key features with NIN. Furthermore, the NIN-type FR likely originated as early as gymnosperms, suggesting that the molecular feature of NIN for RNS regulation was inherited from ancestral NLPs before RNS emerged.
abstract_zh: 固氮根瘤共生（RNS）发生在包括豆科植物在内的某些真双子叶植物中，并由转录因子NODULE INCEPTION（NIN）调控，该转录因子源自NIN-LIKE PROTEIN（NLP）家族。然而，NIN蛋白如何获得RNS特异性功能仍不清楚。我们在百脉根（Lotus japonicus）NIN中鉴定出一个此前未描述的基序，位于RWP-RK结构域下游，并将其命名为FR。该基序通过稳定RWP-RK二聚体界面，拓宽了NIN的DNA结合特异性。缺乏FR基序的nin突变体表现出结瘤缺陷和固氮受损。拟南芥NLP2携带NIN型FR，并与NIN共享关键特征。此外，NIN型FR可能早在裸子植物时期就已起源，这表明NIN用于RNS调控的分子特征是在RNS出现之前从祖先NLP继承而来的。
